channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in Russia's war in Ukraine.

item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia is intensifying airstrikes on Ukrainian energy sites, including power plants in Kyiv and civilian areas in Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries and hit a Russian Iskander-M missile maintenance base. Ukraine also reported hitting six Russian Su-34 bomber jets with a Neptune missile and accused SpaceX of throttling Starlink terminals used for drone operations. Russian authorities detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges and announced a diesel deal framed as an energy ceasefire, which Ukraine rejected as false. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
